name: chat_list
description: Read the DoubaoWork sidebar conversation list from the open chat page via the stable data-testid item rule; zero arguments, read-only.

execution.expression: async () => { const nodes=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="conversation-list-v2-item"]')].slice(0,200); const conversations=nodes.map(el=>{const a=el.closest('a[href]');const m=(a&&a.getAttribute('href')||'').match(/\/chat\/(\d+)/);return {id:m?m[1]:'',title:((el.innerText||'').split('\n')[0]||'').slice(0,200)};}); return {conversationCount:conversations.length,truncated:nodes.length>=200,conversations}; }
